title: Deploy Jenkins with Pipeline
description: Set up Jenkins CI server with pipeline-as-code, credentials management, and a working CI pipeline.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Deploy Jenkins CI server from scratch — install, configure plugins, create pipeline-as-code jobs, and verify a successful build run.

### Environment
- Image: ubuntu:22.04
- Tools: java, jenkins, curl, git
- Login: itadmin / ItLab2025!

### Tasks
1. Install Java JDK 17 and Jenkins LTS
2. Start Jenkins and unlock with initial admin password
3. Install required plugins: Pipeline, Git, Docker, Credentials
4. Create admin user (itadmin / ItLab2025!)
5. Configure Jenkins with pipeline-as-code support
6. Create a Jenkinsfile for a sample Node.js app build
7. Create a pipeline job named lab-pipeline pointing to the Jenkinsfile
8. Run the pipeline and verify build succeeds

### Permissions & Access
- Container runs as root
- Jenkins runs on port 8080
- All verification is done via curl and systemctl
- Credentials stored in /var/secrets/

flags.title: Jenkins Running
flags.description: Run: systemctl status jenkins 2>/dev/null | grep -i active. What is the status?

flags.title: Jenkins Port
flags.description: Run: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8080. What HTTP code?

flags.title: Plugins Installed
flags.description: Run: ls /var/lib/jenkins/plugins/ 2>/dev/null | grep -c pipeline. How many pipeline plugin files?

flags.title: Jenkinsfile Exists
flags.description: Run: ls /home/student/app/Jenkinsfile 2>/dev/null. What is the full path?

flags.title: Pipeline Job
flags.description: Run: curl -s http://localhost:8080/job/lab-pipeline/api/json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d["lastBuild"]["number"])' 2>/dev/null. What is the build number?

flags.title: Build Success
flags.description: Run: curl -s http://localhost:8080/job/lab-pipeline/1/api/json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["result"])' 2>/dev/null. What is the result?

flags.title: Credentials Stored
flags.description: Run: ls /var/secrets/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l. How many secret files?

flags.title: Pipeline Logs
flags.description: Run: curl -s http://localhost:8080/job/lab-pipeline/1/consoleText 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'Finished: SUCCESS'. How many lines match?

title: Deploy GitLab CE with CI Runner

briefing:
